description: This file defines the TypeManifestOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options for known types, serializers, proxies, and related mappings used by the Orleans serialization code generator.

classes.name: TypeManifestOptions
classes.description: A sealed class that holds configuration options for serialization, including sets of types for activators, codecs, serializers, copiers, converters, interfaces, proxies, and mappings for well-known types and aliases.

methods.name: TypeManifestOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing various HashSets and dictionaries for configuration.
